correctness.rationale: For all b>=2 and m>=1, conditional-expectation kernels depend only on longest common prefix. Summation by parts gives K_r=(b-1-2b(-b)^r)/(b+1) off diagonal and K_m=(b-1)(1+(-1)^(m-1)b^m)/(b+1) on diagonal. All kernel coefficients are nonzero with signs fixed by parity; the exact probabilities (b-1)/b^(r+1) and b^-m give the claimed row integral after one geometric-series simplification. Kernel signs attain all rows, symmetry gives L1 dual equality, and orthogonal martingale difference projections give L2 norm 1. Standalone standard-library checker passed 1182 exact-rational assertions across 20 parameter configurations, not used in place of the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: A canonical Haar multiplier with signs alternating across every generation has a complete exact L-infinity and L1 norm formula for all homogeneous branching factors and depths, sharp rowwise extremizers, a parity-sensitive finite-depth boundary correction and branching-dependent leading coefficient. The logarithmic endpoint divergence in leaf count contrasts sharply with the unit Hilbert norm and the bounded all-positive transform. This quantifies a genuine operator-norm boundary phenomenon rather than giving only a single unmotivated small example.
